purpose: Check real spot/perpetual/funding data and transparent cost arithmetic before registering a structural carry strategy. Not an executed portfolio or alpha selection.
symbol_selection: Two core liquid markets fixed before new spot collection. A pilot only; no claim about all40coins, historical investability or optimal carry selection.
spot_time_rule: Pre2025archives use milliseconds;2025onwards microseconds. Raw API samples remain milliseconds. Validate each against exact UTC5m expected clock, never infer API units from archive rules.
funding_source: Binance public read-only connector USD-M funding history;retain exact fundingTime, fundingRate and markPrice. No invented three-event daily schedule or settlement-time rounding.
fee_scope: Spot10bps from current regular-user public schedule without BNB discount, not historical/user-specific account proof. Perp5bps is unchanged research stress assumption, not verified user commission. No staking/lending yield or rebates.
diagnostics: asynchronous connector vs archive sample consistency
spot and perpetual same-clock close basis distribution
actual funding rates and settlement counts by calendar year
simple break-even funding sum for one equal-notional spot-long/perp-short round trip
funding-only fixed-exposure arithmetic explicitly excluding basis/collateral/execution
account_required_before_profit_claim: separate spot cash/assets and futures collateral
basis changes and fees on both legs
causal funding availability and actual settlement mark
asynchronous partial fills and emergency hedge unwind
margin stress/liquidation, transfers and free cash
full lifecycle plus independent audit and JSON recovery
capacity and continuous account vs cash and fixed controls
